name: Gheymat Pardaz
author: Seyed Mohammad Eftekhar

sections.description:
Gheymat Pardaz is a lightweight, secure and standards-compliant plugin for managing WooCommerce product prices based on currency exchange rates.

Main Features

  • Define unlimited currencies (USD, AED, CNY, EUR, …)
  • Price products using a foreign currency amount
  • Automatic final price calculation: Currency Amount × Rate × Markup
  • Support for a fixed “Toman” (IRT) currency that never changes
  • Per-currency markup (profit coefficient) that can be enabled or disabled
  • Smart price rounding (nearest 1,000 / 5,000 / 10,000 or ceil / floor)
  • Complete log of rate changes with date, time and user
  • Optional reference text under the product (customizable + shortcode)
  • Full compatibility with popular cache plugins (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, W3 Total Cache, …)
  • Clean admin interface
  • Fully compliant with WordPress.org coding standards

How It Works

  1. Go to Gheymat Pardaz → Currencies and define the currencies you need with the current rates.
  2. Edit a simple product and set the currency and the amount in that currency.
  3. The final price in the store currency is calculated automatically and saved in the standard WooCommerce price fields.
  4. Whenever you change a currency rate, all related product prices are updated immediately.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gheymat-pardaz directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Gheymat Pardaz in the admin menu and define your currencies.
sections.faq:
Does it support Variable products?

Version 1.0 supports Simple products only. Variable product support will be added in a future release.

Is it compatible with cache plugins?

Yes. When a currency rate changes, related product caches are cleared intelligently.

Are the prices stored in the database?

Yes. The final price is stored in the standard WooCommerce _price and _regular_price meta fields.
